        'column_name': column_name,

        'missing_values': data.isnull().sum()[0],
        'unique_values': data.nunique(),
        'top_values': data.value_counts().head(20).to_dict()
    }
    
    # Distribution analysis

        # Numeric analysis
        profile['distribution'] = {
            'skewness': stats.skew(col_data[~pd.isna(col_data)]),

            model = IsolationForest(contamination='auto')
            preds = model.fit_predict(numeric_data.reshape(-1, 1))
            profile['outliers_isolation_forest'] = {
                'outlier_count': len(numeric_data) - sum(preds == 1)
            }
